messages:
sana: FYI while bringing up tengu-lite:q4f on staging, we see a clear chrF/bleu regression for mixed zh+ar testset (mixscript-brackets). attaching repro and notes.

sana: symptom: paired punctuation (（）, 【】, « ») next to Arabic segments get flipped or get spacing inserted in q4f runs. float baseline and q8-fallback look fine.

sana: quick example that fails consistently: source: "订单编号（رقم الطلب：٢٣٤）已确认。"
  - float decode -> "Order # (رقم الطلب: 234) has been confirmed."
  - q4f decode -> "Order # ( ر ق م  ا ل ط ل ب : 2 3 4 ) has been confirmed." (Arabic letters are space-separated / characters split)

lia: that's scary. looks like the token merging for RTL script is broken in the q4f tokenization/gen path, possibly due to new matmul_opt v2 packing (commit f2b4).

tom_k: timeline: matmul_opt v2 landed yesterday on staging. build-bot shows q4f quant compiler + new packing routine enabled.

sana: repro command (staging):
```bash
python run_eval.py --model tengu-lite:q4f --dataset mixscript-brackets --split smoke-500 --batch 8 --detok detok_mixed.py --save-dump /tmp/tengu_q4f_dump.json
```

sana: quick diff from dump: the generation step emits separated Arabic grapheme tokens in q4f: e.g. float ids -> [1201, 445, 3021] (single Arabic token) ; q4f ids -> [1201, 89, 90, 91, 3021] (split into several small-piece tokens which later detok inserts spaces).

eval-bot: automated metrics snapshot:
- model: tengu-lite:q4f
- dataset: mixscript-brackets/smoke-500
- metric: chrF / BLEU
- float baseline: chrF 0.712 / BLEU 28.4
- q4f (staging+matmul_opt v2): chrF 0.651 / BLEU 24.7
- q8 (fallback): chrF 0.710 / BLEU 28.1

sana: interestingly, when we set --no-subtoken-split in serving (a knob to disable subtoken splitting for small piece tokens) the q4f output improves a lot (BLEU -> 27.8). so it's a combination of quant packing + subtokenization on the runtime side.

tom_k: can you try running q4f with the older matmul packing? build-bot: I can create a build that pins packer to v1 for canary.

sana: will try that and dump diffs. also trying q4f + disable-rtl-reorder flag in the tokenizer to see if downstream detok reordering fixes it.

lia: theory: q4f kernel uses a different byte-alignment during embedding lookup which can change the micro-batching of small unicode clusters. when clusters for Arabic are split, detok_mixed's RTL reordering sees spaces between clusters and produces spaced-out Arabic.

tom_k: lia, can you produce a minimal unit test that verifies token-level roundtrip for bidi scripts on quantized paths? we need an automated parity test added to onboarding pipeline.

lia: yes, I'll add a unittest in infra/tests/token_roundtrip_test.py that runs for q4f/q8/fp16 variants and fails if token id sequences differ for same input bytes.

build-bot: pinned builds available: packer_v1-q4f (staging) and matmul_opt_v2-q4f (current). specify --build packer_v1 if you want to test packer_v1-q4f.

sana: quick results: q4f + packer_v1 recovers most: BLEU 27.9 chrF 0.699. so packer v2 seems to be main regression vector; disable-subtoken-split helps as mitigation.

tom_k: next steps agreed: (1) lia to open a regression ticket and add token-roundtrip unit; (2) build team to hold packer_v2 in canary until we revert/patch; (3) add the failing mixscript-brackets sample to regression corpus.

sana: opening tickets now. ticket IDs: INF-ML-3821 (packer_v2 investigation), INF-ML-3822 (token-roundtrip unit + regression harness).

eval-bot: note: added mixscript-brackets/failcases/zh_ar_bracket_001.txt to regressions.

lia: I'll PR the unit test and a small fix that forces canonical clusterization before packing. if that doesn't cut it, we'll fallback to disabling subtoken-split in q4f builds until proper kernel parity is restored.

build-bot: rolling hold placed on packer_v2 for production fleets until INF-ML-3821 triaged.

sana: thanks all. keeping thread open for updates. :memo:
